data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Helios', meaning 'Sun' or 'Sun god'. In ancient Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun, and his name is the root of the English word 'helianthus', meaning sunflower. The name Haldi carries the meaning “Sun god” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Haldi usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
